original.description: Three-quarter-length portrait of General Charles Lanrezac in French general's full dress — bicorne with plumes, dark-blue double-breasted tunic, gold epaulettes and sash, Légion d'honneur — as reproduced in Gabriel Hanotaux, Histoire illustrée de la guerre de 1914, vol. 4 (Paris: Gounouilhou, 1916).

caption: Charles Lanrezac (1852–1925), commander of the French 5th Army — saw the German wheel coming before Joffre believed it, was mauled at Charleroi, counterattacked at Guise, and was dismissed on 3 September, three days before the Marne. Colorized (AI-assisted) from a public-domain photograph.
credit: Original photograph: anonymous, reproduced in Hanotaux, Histoire illustrée de la guerre de 1914 (1916); public domain (via Wikimedia Commons). Colorization: Sandtable, AI-assisted, 2026.
